summary: PII shield fix: a known value that is part of a longer one (max@firma.de in johannes.max@firma.de) no longer leaves the rest of the longer one in plain text in tool results and the view context. Output is unchanged whenever no known value is part of another.
howTo: Nothing to configure; upgrade if the app uses piiShield. anonymizeResult, inbound and rehydrateArgs now replace known values longest first in one pass; before, a shorter value learnt earlier broke the longer one (johannes.<pseudonym>, <pseudonym>/u/max.mustermann@firma.de) and a suffixed pseudonym (Anna Müller-1) was restored as the original of Anna Müller plus -1. Tests that pinned such pseudonymized output must expect the longer value's pseudonym now. Known limit: of two values that overlap without one containing the other (37/1571/24067 and 24067Z.huber@kanzlei-x.de), the rest of the shorter one stays in plain text.
